title: Peruvian Chicken Skewers with Tomatoes
description: Grilled Peruvian chicken skewers with fresh tomatoes, perfect for a keto diet. This dish is a healthy and flavorful option for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: La Brasa Wood Chips (or regular wood chips)

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, aji amarillo pepper, and oil to make marinade.
2. Add chicken pieces to marinade and mix well to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
5. Thread marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
6. Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
7. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until chicken is cooked through.
8. Meanwhile, grill tomato wedges for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
9. Serve chicken skewers with grilled tomatoes and your choice of sides.
